# Small helper used throughout to render a data frame as a clean, styled table
pretty_table <- function(df, caption = NULL, ...) {
  df %>%
    kable(format = "html", caption = caption, digits = 2, ...) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "condensed"),
                  full_width = FALSE, position = "left")
}

# Overview

Preliminary cleaning and analysis of the Project 3, Aim 2 baseline survey. Results come first; the full data cleaning and scoring code is in [Methods](#methods) at the end. Use the **Code** buttons to show or hide the R code behind any table or chart.

# Key Findings

```{r key findings data, include=FALSE}
domains <- c("Focus", "Support", "Recognition")

ic_domain <- tibble(Domain = domains) %>%
  mutate(
    Self   = map_dbl(Domain, ~ mean(df[[paste0("IC_", .x, "_Self")]], na.rm = TRUE)),
    Clinic = map_dbl(Domain, ~ mean(df[[paste0("IC_", .x, "_Clinic")]], na.rm = TRUE))
  )

n_total   <- nrow(df)
clinic_n  <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Clinic)) %>% count(Clinic)
largest   <- clinic_n %>% slice_max(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
smallest  <- clinic_n %>% slice_min(n, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
lowest    <- ic_domain %>% slice_min(Self, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE)
others    <- ic_domain %>% filter(Domain != lowest$Domain)
all_higher <- all(ic_domain$Clinic > ic_domain$Self)

f2 <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = 2)
pct <- function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%")
```

::: {.key-findings}

```{r key findings, echo=FALSE, results="asis"}
gap_text <- paste0(ic_domain$Domain, " ", f2(ic_domain$Clinic), " vs. ", f2(ic_domain$Self),
                   collapse = "; ")

bullets <- c(
  paste0("**", n_total, " staff completed the baseline survey** across ", nrow(clinic_n),
         " clinics. ", largest$Clinic, " makes up ", pct(largest$n / sum(clinic_n$n)),
         " of the sample."),
  paste0("**", lowest$Domain, " is the weakest part of implementation climate.** ",
         "Staff rated their own experience of it at ", f2(lowest$Self), " on a 1–5 scale, ",
         "compared with ", f2(others$Self[1]), " for ", others$Domain[1], " and ",
         f2(others$Self[2]), " for ", others$Domain[2], "."),
  if (all_higher) {
    paste0("**Staff rate their clinic more favorably than themselves** in all three areas ",
           "(clinic vs. self: ", gap_text, "). See [Self vs. Clinic](#self-vs-clinic).")
  } else {
    paste0("**Clinic and self ratings differ by area** (clinic vs. self: ", gap_text,
           "). See [Self vs. Clinic](#self-vs-clinic).")
  },
  paste0("**Team psychological safety averages ", f2(mean(df$EPSC_Total, na.rm = TRUE)),
         "** on a 1–7 scale, and collaboration on care decisions averages ",
         f2(mean(df$CSACD_Collaboration, na.rm = TRUE)), "."),
  paste0("**Clinic groups are small** (", smallest$Clinic, ": n = ", smallest$n,
         "), so differences between clinics should be read as descriptive.")
)

cat(paste0("- ", bullets, collapse = "\n"), "\n")
```

# Self vs. Clinic {#self-vs-clinic}

Each Implementation Climate area is asked twice: about the respondent's own experience ("self") and about their clinic as a whole ("clinic").

```{r self vs clinic plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=3.6}
ci_long <- df %>%
  select(starts_with("IC_") & (ends_with("_Self") | ends_with("_Clinic"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = c("Domain", "Rater"),
               names_pattern = "IC_(.*)_(Self|Clinic)") %>%
  filter(!is.na(value)) %>%
  group_by(Domain, Rater) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), mean = mean(value), se = sd(value) / sqrt(n),
            lo = mean - qt(0.975, n - 1) * se,
            hi = mean + qt(0.975, n - 1) * se, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(Domain = factor(Domain, levels = rev(domains)),
         Rater  = factor(Rater, levels = c("Self", "Clinic")))

seg <- ci_long %>% select(Domain, Rater, mean) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Rater, values_from = mean)

ggplot(ci_long, aes(x = mean, y = Domain, color = Rater)) +
  geom_segment(data = seg, aes(x = Self, xend = Clinic, y = Domain, yend = Domain),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, color = "grey75", linewidth = 2.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), width = 0.15, linewidth = 0.6, alpha = 0.6,
                orientation = "y") +
  geom_point(size = 4.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = f2(mean)), vjust = -1.3, size = 3.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(Self = col_self, Clinic = col_clinic),
                     labels = c(Self = "About myself", Clinic = "About my clinic"), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, 5), breaks = 1:5,
                     labels = c("1\nCompletely\ndisagree", "2", "3", "4", "5\nCompletely\nagree")) +
  labs(title = if (all_higher) "Staff rate their clinic higher than themselves in every area"
               else "Self and clinic ratings of implementation climate",
       subtitle = "Mean with 95% confidence interval",
       x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_report()
```

```{r self vs clinic tests}
paired_tests <- map_dfr(domains, function(d) {
  s <- df[[paste0("IC_", d, "_Self")]]
  cl <- df[[paste0("IC_", d, "_Clinic")]]
  ok <- !is.na(s) & !is.na(cl)
  w <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(cl[ok], s[ok], paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE))
  tibble(Area = d, n = sum(ok),
         `Self mean` = mean(s[ok]), `Clinic mean` = mean(cl[ok]),
         `Difference (clinic − self)` = mean(cl[ok] - s[ok]),
         `p (Wilcoxon signed-rank)` = w$p.value)
}) %>%
  mutate(`p (Holm-adjusted)` = p.adjust(`p (Wilcoxon signed-rank)`, method = "holm"),
         across(c(`p (Wilcoxon signed-rank)`, `p (Holm-adjusted)`),
                ~ ifelse(.x < 0.001, "< .001", formatC(.x, format = "f", digits = 3))))

pretty_table(paired_tests, caption = "Paired comparison of self vs. clinic ratings")
```

# Item-Level Responses

How respondents answered each of the 12 Implementation Climate items.

```{r ic items plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5.2}
ic_item_info <- tibble(
  item   = paste0("IC_", 1:12),
  Domain = rep(c("Focus", "Focus", "Support", "Support", "Recognition", "Recognition"), 2),
  Rater  = rep(c("Self", "Clinic"), each = 6)
) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(Domain, " · ", tolower(Rater), " (", item, ")"))

ic_items_long <- df %>%
  select(all_of(ic_item_info$item)) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "item", values_to = "response") %>%
  filter(!is.na(response)) %>%
  count(item, response) %>%
  group_by(item) %>% mutate(share = n / sum(n)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  left_join(ic_item_info, by = "item") %>%
  mutate(response = factor(response, levels = 5:1),
         label = factor(label, levels = rev(ic_item_info$label[order(
           match(ic_item_info$Domain, domains), ic_item_info$Rater == "Clinic")])))

agree_share <- ic_items_long %>%
  filter(response %in% c("4", "5")) %>%
  group_by(label) %>% summarise(agree = sum(share), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(ic_items_long, aes(x = share, y = label, fill = response)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72) +
  geom_text(data = agree_share, aes(x = 1.02, y = label, label = pct(agree)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = 0, size = 3.4, color = "grey25") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("5" = "#1F5FA8", "4" = "#7FB1E3", "3" = "#D9D9D9",
                               "2" = "#F2A97E", "1" = "#C8553D"),
                    breaks = as.character(1:5),
                    labels = c("1 Completely disagree", "2", "3", "4", "5 Completely agree"),
                    name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(x * 100), "%"),
                     breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))) +
  labs(title = "Share of respondents choosing each answer",
       subtitle = "Number at right = % who agree (4 or 5)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_report() +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, reverse = FALSE))
```

main_scores <- c("IC_Total", "EPSC_Total", "CSACD_Collaboration")
facet_titles <- c(IC_Total = "Implementation Climate (1–5)",

box_df <- df %>%

ggplot(box_df, aes(x = value, y = fct_rev(Clinic_lab))) +

## Table and tests

Mean (SD) for every score. Shading runs from lighter (lower) to darker (higher) within each row. Kruskal-Wallis tests whether scores differ across clinics; ε² is the effect size (roughly .01 small, .08 medium, .26 large).

```{r clinic table}
clinic_levels <- levels(droplevels(df$Clinic[!is.na(df$Clinic)]))

kw <- map_dfr(score_vars, function(v) {
  d <- df %>% filter(!is.na(Clinic), !is.na(.data[[v]]))
  t <- kruskal.test(d[[v]] ~ droplevels(d$Clinic))
  tibble(score = v, H = unname(t$statistic), p = t$p.value,
         eps2 = unname(t$statistic) / (nrow(d) - 1))
}) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, method = "holm"))

stats_long <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Clinic)) %>%
  select(Clinic, all_of(score_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Clinic, names_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(score, Clinic) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), s = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(score) %>%
  mutate(shade = (m - min(m)) / max(max(m) - min(m), 1e-9)) %>%
  ungroup()

shade_col <- colorRampPalette(c("#F4F8FB", "#9EC5EE"))(101)

cells <- stats_long %>%
  mutate(cell = cell_spec(paste0(f2(m), " (", f2(s), ")"),
                          background = shade_col[round(shade * 100) + 1],
                          color = "#1b1b1b")) %>%
  select(score, Clinic, cell) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Clinic, values_from = cell)

fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "< .001", formatC(p, format = "f", digits = 3))

clinic_comparison <- cells %>%
  left_join(kw, by = "score") %>%
  mutate(score = factor(score, levels = score_vars)) %>%
  arrange(score) %>%
  transmute(Score = score_labels[as.character(score)],
            !!!syms(clinic_levels),
            `ε²` = f2(eps2), p = fmt_p(p), `p (Holm)` = fmt_p(p_holm))

clinic_n_lab <- clinic_n %>% mutate(lab = paste0(Clinic, "<br><span class='note-small'>n = ", n, "</span>"))
names(clinic_comparison)[match(clinic_levels, names(clinic_comparison))] <-
  clinic_n_lab$lab[match(clinic_levels, clinic_n_lab$Clinic)]

clinic_comparison %>%
  kable(format = "html", escape = FALSE, align = c("l", rep("c", length(clinic_levels)), "r", "r", "r"),
        caption = "Mean (SD) by clinic, with Kruskal-Wallis tests") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("hover", "condensed"), full_width = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  pack_rows("Implementation Climate (1–5)", 1, 7) %>%
  pack_rows("Psychological Safety (1–7)", 8, 8) %>%
  pack_rows("Care Decisions (CSACD)", 9, 11) %>%
  scroll_box(width = "100%")
```

## Implementation team

Orthopedics only. With `r sum(df$impteam == 1 & df$Clinic %in% "Orthopedics")` team members, this comparison is descriptive and not tested.

```{r impteam table}
impteam_long <- df %>%
  filter(Clinic == "Orthopedics", !is.na(impteam)) %>%
  mutate(impteam = factor(impteam, levels = c(0, 1),
                          labels = c("Not on team", "Implementation team"))) %>%
  select(impteam, all_of(score_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(-impteam, names_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(score, impteam) %>%
  summarise(cell = paste0(f2(mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)), " (", f2(sd(value, na.rm = TRUE)), ")"),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = impteam, values_from = cell) %>%
  mutate(score = factor(score, levels = score_vars)) %>%
  arrange(score) %>%
  mutate(Score = score_labels[as.character(score)]) %>%
  select(Score, everything(), -score)

team_n <- df %>% filter(Clinic == "Orthopedics") %>% count(impteam)
names(impteam_long)[-1] <- paste0(names(impteam_long)[-1], " (n = ",
                                  team_n$n[match(c(0, 1), team_n$impteam)], ")")

pretty_table(impteam_long, caption = "Mean (SD) by implementation team status, Orthopedics")
```

# Reliability (Cronbach's Alpha)

```{r reliability}
alpha_row <- function(data, items, label) {
  a <- suppressWarnings(psych::alpha(data[, items], check.keys = TRUE))
  tibble(
    Scale = label,
    `# Items` = length(items),
    `Raw Alpha` = round(a$total$raw_alpha, 2),
    `Std. Alpha` = round(a$total$std.alpha, 2),
    `Mean` = round(a$total$mean, 2),
    `SD` = round(a$total$sd, 2)
  )
}

reliability_table <- bind_rows(
  alpha_row(df, ic_items, "IC — All 12 items"),
  alpha_row(df, c("IC_1","IC_2","IC_7","IC_8"), "IC — Focus subscale"),
  alpha_row(df, c("IC_3","IC_4","IC_9","IC_10"), "IC — Support subscale"),
  alpha_row(df, c("IC_5","IC_6","IC_11","IC_12"), "IC — Recognition subscale"),
  alpha_row(df, c("EPSC_1_r","EPSC_2","EPSC_3_r","EPSC_4","EPSC_5_r","EPSC_6","EPSC_7"), "EPSC — All 7 items (reverse-coded)"),
  alpha_row(df, csacd1_items, "CSACD.I — Collaboration")
)

pretty_table(reliability_table, caption = "Scale Reliability Summary") %>%
  column_spec(3, color = ifelse(reliability_table$`Raw Alpha` >= 0.7, "#1b1b1b", "#C8553D"),
              bold = reliability_table$`Raw Alpha` < 0.7) %>%
  kableExtra::footnote(general = "Values below .70 are shown in red.", general_title = "")
```

# Methods {#methods}

The code below runs at the start of the report (before the results above); it is shown here for reference.

## Initial Cleaning & Renaming

```{r cleaning, eval=FALSE}
# Remove exported qualtrics labels first two rows
df <- df %>%
  slice(-(1:2))

# Filter if unfinished
df <- df %>%
  filter(Finished == 1)

# Rename other vars
df <- df %>%
  rename(ID = `Last.4.Dig.Phone..`,
         position = `Job.Title`)

# Drop Qualtrics preview/test responses if present
if ("DistributionChannel" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(DistributionChannel != "preview")
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = as.factor(Gender),
    Race = as.factor(Race),
    Ethnicity = as.factor(Ethnicity),
    position = as.factor(position),
    Clinic = as.factor(Clinic),
    Experience = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(Experience))
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Clinic_raw = as.character(Clinic),
    Clinic = case_when(
      is.na(Clinic_raw)              ~ NA_character_,
      Clinic_raw == "1,2"            ~ "Gastroenterology",   # Adolescent + Endocrinology -> Gastro
      Clinic_raw == "2,5"            ~ "Endocrinology",      # Endocrinology + Other -> Endocrinology
      Clinic_raw == "3,5"            ~ "Gastroenterology",   # Gastro + Other ("Infectious diseases")
      Clinic_raw == "4,5"            ~ "Orthopedics",        # Ortho + Other ("OR, ED, Rehab")
      Clinic_raw == "1"              ~ "Adolescent Young Adult Medicine",
      Clinic_raw == "2"              ~ "Endocrinology",
      Clinic_raw == "3"              ~ "Gastroenterology",
      Clinic_raw == "4"              ~ "Orthopedics",
      TRUE                            ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Clinic = factor(Clinic, levels = c("Adolescent Young Adult Medicine",
                                        "Endocrinology",
                                        "Gastroenterology",
                                        "Orthopedics"))
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = factor(Gender,
                     levels = c(1, 2, 7),
                     labels = c("Woman", "Man", "Prefer not to answer")),

    Race = factor(Race,
                   levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8),
                   labels = c("White", "Black or African American",
                              "American Indian or Native Alaskan",
                              "Asian", "Native Hawaiian or Pacific Islander",
                              "More than one", "Other", "Prefer not to answer")),

    Ethnicity = factor(Ethnicity,
                        levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                        labels = c("Hispanic", "Non-Hispanic", "Prefer not to answer"))
  )

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    position_temp = position %>%
      as.character() %>%
      str_squish() %>%
      str_to_lower(),

    position_group = case_when(
      # --- Physician ---
      str_detect(position_temp, "orthopaedic surgeon|orthopedic surgeon") ~ "Physician",
      str_detect(position_temp, "gastroenterologist|hepatologist")        ~ "Physician",
      str_detect(position_temp, "clinical professor")                    ~ "Physician",
      str_detect(position_temp, "\\bmd\\b|^physician$")                  ~ "Physician",

      # --- Physician Assistant ---
      str_detect(position_temp, "physician assistant|\\bpa-c\\b|\\bpa\\b") ~ "Physician Assistant",

      # --- RN / Nurse Practitioner ---
      str_detect(position_temp, "nurse practitioner|\\bcpnp\\b")         ~ "RN / Nurse Practitioner",
      str_detect(position_temp, "\\brn\\b")                             ~ "RN / Nurse Practitioner",

      # --- Medical Assistant / Patient Access ---
      str_detect(position_temp, "cma.?par|ma.?par")                     ~ "Medical Assistant / Patient Access",
      str_detect(position_temp, "medical assistant|\\bcma\\b")          ~ "Medical Assistant / Patient Access",
      str_detect(position_temp, "patient access rep|\\bpar\\b")         ~ "Medical Assistant / Patient Access",

      # --- Allied Health / Technician ---
      str_detect(position_temp, "athletic trainer")                    ~ "Allied Health / Technician",
      str_detect(position_temp, "ortho.*tech")                         ~ "Allied Health / Technician",

      # --- Other Staff ---
      str_detect(position_temp, "social worker")                       ~ "Other Staff",
      str_detect(position_temp, "research coordinator")                ~ "Other Staff",
      str_detect(position_temp, "medical student")                     ~ "Other Staff",
      str_detect(position_temp, "admin associate|operations manager|supervisor") ~ "Other Staff",

      TRUE ~ "Other Staff"
    ),
    position_group = as.factor(position_group)
  ) %>%
  select(-position_temp)

# Implementation team membership (1 = member), cross-referenced from team meeting rosters.
# The member IDs are kept in a local file next to the survey export, NOT in this code,
# so they never appear on the public page. The file has one column named "ID".
ids_file <- file.path(data_dir, "ImpTeam_IDs.csv")
stopifnot("ImpTeam_IDs.csv not found in the data folder" = file.exists(ids_file))
impteam_ids <- read.csv(ids_file, colClasses = "character")$ID

df <- df %>%
  mutate(impteam = if_else(ID %in% impteam_ids, 1, 0))
```

## Scale Scoring

### Implementation Climate (IC)

Scale: 1 (Completely disagree) to 5 (Completely agree). No reverse-coded items.

```{r ic scoring, eval=FALSE}
ic_items <- paste0("IC_", 1:12)
stopifnot(all(ic_items %in% names(df)))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ic_items), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    IC_Focus_Self         = rowMeans(across(c(IC_1, IC_2)), na.rm = TRUE),
    IC_Focus_Clinic        = rowMeans(across(c(IC_7, IC_8)), na.rm = TRUE),
    IC_Support_Self       = rowMeans(across(c(IC_3, IC_4)), na.rm = TRUE),
    IC_Support_Clinic      = rowMeans(across(c(IC_9, IC_10)), na.rm = TRUE),
    IC_Recognition_Self   = rowMeans(across(c(IC_5, IC_6)), na.rm = TRUE),
    IC_Recognition_Clinic  = rowMeans(across(c(IC_11, IC_12)), na.rm = TRUE),
    IC_Total = rowMeans(across(all_of(ic_items)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

### Team Psychological Safety (EPSC, Edmondson)

Scale: 1–7. Items 1, 3, and 5 are reverse-scored.

```{r epsc scoring, eval=FALSE}
epsc_items <- paste0("EPSC_", 1:7)
stopifnot(all(epsc_items %in% names(df)))

df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(epsc_items), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    EPSC_1_r = 8 - EPSC_1,
    EPSC_3_r = 8 - EPSC_3,
    EPSC_5_r = 8 - EPSC_5,
    EPSC_Total = rowMeans(
      across(c(EPSC_1_r, EPSC_2, EPSC_3_r, EPSC_4, EPSC_5_r, EPSC_6, EPSC_7)),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

### Collaboration & Satisfaction About Care Decisions (CSACD)

- **CSACD.I** — Collaboration (6 items, 1–7 scale) → averaged
- **CSACD.II** — Satisfaction with decision (1 item) → used as-is
- **CSACD.III** — Decision-making pattern (2 items, 1–7 scale) → averaged

```{r csacd scoring, eval=FALSE}
csacd1_items <- paste0("CSACD.I_", 1:6)
stopifnot(all(csacd1_items %in% names(df)))

likert_cols <- c(paste0("IC_", 1:12), paste0("EPSC_", 1:7),
                  paste0("CSACD.I_", 1:6), "CSACD.II_1", "CSACD.III_1", "CSACD.III_2")

df <- df %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(likert_cols), as.numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    CSACD_Collaboration = rowMeans(across(all_of(csacd1_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    CSACD_Satisfaction   = CSACD.II_1,
    CSACD_DecisionMaking = rowMeans(across(c(CSACD.III_1, CSACD.III_2)), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```
